newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco copper output at 1.6 mln tonnes in 2001.
newsitem.headline: Codelco copper output at 1.6 mln tonnes in 2001.

text.p: Chile state copper company Codelco expects production to rise to 1.6 million tonnes in the year 2001 as a result of the startup of Radomiro Tomic and two other large projects, said president Marcos Lima.
The company's four mines produced 1.22 million tonnes of copper last year, up 55,000 tonnes from 1995 levels.
"This forecast takes into account the expansion of Andina, the startup at Radomiro Tomic and part of the Esmeralda project (at El Teniente)," Lima told Reuters.

The 150,000-tonne a year copper oxides mine Radomiro Tomic mine near Chuquicamata mine, currently Codelco's biggest project, is due to come on line sometime in early 1998. Expansion at Andina has been underway for about the past year.
